```plato

// A 3D rotation representation: converts to a unit quaternion, the canonical
// form every 3D rotation shares. A rotation is the rigid transform whose
// translation is zero, hence the inheritance.
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation
interface IRotational3D
    inherits IRigid3D
{
    Quaternion(x: Self): Quaternion;
}
```
